comparisonWithLocalRubric.ourText: Describe the sources and uses of oil, coal and natural gas.
Describe how the use of fossil fuels impacts human health and the environment.
Describe the technologies used to generate renewable energy.
Describe the advantages and disadvantages of using nuclear fuels.
Describe the social, environmental and financial advantages of increasing use of renewable energy.
Describe the disadvantages of increasing use of renewable energy.
Explain how the use of fossil fuels affects human health and the environment.
Explain and compare the efficiency of different renewable energy sources.
Compare the social, environmental and financial advantages and disadvantages of using nuclear energy and biofuels as energy sources.
Evaluate the impact of fossil fuels on human health and the environment.
Evaluate the factors that affect the efficiency of methods used to generate energy.
Evaluate the benefits and detrimental effects of increased use of solar, wind, hydroelectric, biomass, and geothermal power.
